description: This file defines a PHP class 'OA_Api_Xmlrpc' that provides methods for interacting with an XML-RPC web service API for OpenX Revive Adserver. It includes functions for managing entities like agencies, campaigns, banners, publishers, zones, and users, as well as retrieving statistics and linking entities.

classes.name: OA_Api_Xmlrpc
classes.description: A PHP class providing XML-RPC routines to manipulate OpenX objects via web services API.

methods.description: Constructor initializing connection parameters and performing login.

methods.description: Sends an XML-RPC request to the server and processes the response.

methods.description: Logs off from the web service.
